title: SDK build farm: clone the private core and build every platform, then publish to kih bin
desc: The road for ANY core build or seat-binary refresh: kiexpert/wkappbot-sdk platform-release.yml clones WKAppBot (clone-core.sh), builds linux-x64, osx-arm64, osx-x64, win-x64 on native runners, verifies each, and publish-to-kih pushes the binaries plus MANIFEST into kih bin/; works while the private core repo Actions are billing-blocked. Build output is not secret (owner 2026-11-08). Also the original macOS relay test.
steps: Environment: Runner macos-latest, .NET 8.0.x, Clones kiexpert/WKAppBot private core with WKAPPBOT_CORE_PAT secret //why:build farm road now ranks first for core build //why:sdk root ordered to own per platform release pipeline //why:sdk root ordered to own per platform release pipeline-unknown //why:build farm road now ranks first for core build-unknown

Workflow Steps: (1) Checkout wkappbot-sdk repository (2) Setup .NET 8.0.x environment (3) Clone WKAppBot core repo (depth=1 is fine for the build, but the core version patch is a git commit COUNT since the bump commit, and on Windows the MSBuild Exec .bat removed the lone percent, so git got --format=H, rejected it and printed no sha, and the count silently became 0 even on a full clone (core PR 191 escapes it as %%H; PR 192 makes a failed lookup warn loudly); either way pass WKAPPBOT_PATCH or -p:WKAppBotPatch=N to every platform job, and each verify leg requires --version to end in .N (run 42484859030: linux and both osx legs passed .33 while win-x64 still failed that check, so prove the Windows leg receives the override before calling it fixed; owner 2026-11-08: the browser-wasm job is advisory and never blocks publish-to-kih, the four native legs ship as soon as they are green; a version gate greps the ^wkappbot v line, never the first output line, because the Windows core logs an [ACT] line first -- run 42486972372 then read .34 on all four); measured 2026-11-08, win-x64 printed v7.12.0 while the portable builds printed v7.12.25, and the first guess, clone depth, was wrong) (4) Print .NET environment via dotnet --info (5) Conditionally build Portable.slnf if available

Output handling: Success shows Build completed successfully, Failure shows exit code N with tail last 20 lines, Not available gracefully exits 0 //why:run 42486972372 four legs print v7.12.34 //why:run 42486972372 four legs print v7.12.34-unknown
To trigger: gh workflow run macos-test.yml --repo kiexpert/wkappbot-sdk //why:respawned leg is a fresh dispatch run //why:respawned leg is a fresh dispatch run-unknown
Public Log Hygiene: Token never echoed, only summary to console, no paths disclosed //why:public relay host for portal needs owner approval before any public repo exists

PHASE 1 COMPLETE (2026-09-30, run 36676298999): macOS CI PASS. Root cause of CI failure: <TargetFrameworks> containing net8.0-windows* causes MSBuild to refuse project evaluation on non-Windows hosts unless EnableWindowsTargeting=true is set. Fix: added to csharp/Directory.Build.props. Also: latestPatch->latestFeature in global.json (precaution), direct stdout in workflow Build step (no set-e+redirect conflict). All 4 portable projects build net8.0 clean: Abstractions, PluginContract, Android, Example.Plugin. //why:five platform legs all passed door on 0.3.17 //why:five platform legs all passed door on 0.3.17-unknown

Trigger: GitHub Actions workflow runs on macOS-latest via workflow_dispatch or repository_dispatch; ROAD for a flaky runner network (owner 2026-11-09): a leg whose hosts still fail after curl --retry 6 --retry-delay 5 dispatches a fresh run of itself (respawn at most 2, the third failure is a real red) instead of reporting red, reusing the *** road in kiexpert/*** maejip_relay.yml (self-chain by workflow_dispatch, newest run wins via _active_run_id) (type: macos-test). SUPERSEDED FOR RELEASES (2026-10-23): kiexpert/wkappbot-sdk .github/workflows/platform-release.yml (with scripts clone-core.sh, docs/platform-release.md) builds linux-x64, osx-arm64, osx-x64 and win-x64 on native runners, verifies each (--version, skill read on-load, install.sh checksum), writes SHA256SUMS and attaches assets on a v*-sdk tag (core over 100 MB ships as wkappbot-core.exe.xz). Run 39898608084 on branch claude/release-v7.12.0-sdk passed all 4 builds and 4 verifies (reported by the SDK root). Manual run once on main: gh workflow run platform-release.yml --repo kiexpert/wkappbot-sdk -f core_ref=main. BUILD FARM (owner 2026-10-24): the SDK repo builds core + launcher for every platform from a WKAppBot clone, gates on QA (verify jobs + kih tools/wk-harness-qa.sh), then publish-to-kih pushes the binaries into kih bin/ (wk-bin-acquire.sh publish) with an owner PAT the SDK ALREADY holds -- the one the private relays push with; owner 2026-11-08: never invent a new secret name such as KIH_PUSH_PAT and ask him to fill it, reuse the token already in use; the core repo only TRIGGERS it (repository_dispatch core-updated with the core sha, secret SDK_DISPATCH_PAT, workflow trigger-sdk-build.yml or bin/wk-trigger-sdk-build.sh), and an hourly SDK cron polls core main as the fallback. RELEASE ROAD (SDK PR 506, 2026-11-08): every green main farm run publishes or refreshes v<core X.Y.N>-sdk with the verified assets plus SHA256SUMS and marks it latest, because npm wkappbot-code fetches the core from releases/latest (before 506 the release job ran only on a tag push, so a cloud-VM install of 0.3.11 got v7.12.8; v7.12.34-sdk became latest in run 42490692056). PR 508: publish-to-kih compares against every file kih holds for the platform, so a no-change acquire is up to date instead of rc 1. PR 510 npm release gate: approved list, latest core >= kih bin core, and packed-tgz os-qa green on four legs before publish. RESULT 2026-11-08: wkappbot-code 0.3.12 passed it in run 42509848799 and PR 513 copied the same bytes to both Pages URLs (run 42510836852, sha256 b014fa57 on npm, wkappbot-code/ and appbot-code/); every verify install there runs under a throw-away HOME, because a real-HOME install wires the push gate that then refuses the gh-pages push. A relay red on every tick (model-sim-relay since 13:06 on 2026-11-08) goes to the SDK root that owns the workflow, with the run ids and an order to fix the cause, never to mute the check (fixed same day, SDK PR 514, green run 42523855943: the commit step ran git add on a queue folder that git does not keep when empty, so stage a folder only when it exists or still has tracked files). //why:0.3.13 waits on that gate at 6b2b033 //why:run 42474691236 rebuilds with QA fix-unknown //why:farm rerun waits on KIH_PUSH_PAT secret-unknown //why:0.3.13 waits on that gate at 6b2b033-unknown //why:explains why the publish run leaves kih untouched //why:the pages harness publish follows the same relay road
